description: This file defines a template class 'LinkType' for managing JSON-RPC communication over WebSocket channels, including nested classes for communication channels, message handling, and connection management. It also provides a 'SmartLinkType' class for higher-level client interactions, including subscription, invocation, and property management within a JSON-RPC framework.

classes.name: LinkType
classes.description: A template class managing JSON-RPC communication over WebSocket channels, including nested classes for communication channels, message handling, and connection management.

classes.name: SmartLinkType
classes.description: A higher-level client class providing subscription, invocation, and property management functionalities within the JSON-RPC framework.

classes.name: CommunicationChannel
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication, message sending/receiving, and connection state management.

classes.name: ChannelImpl
classes.description: Implements the core JSON stream over WebSocket, managing message transmission and reception.

classes.name: ChannelProxy
classes.description: Proxy object managing the lifecycle of communication channels, including creation, release, and connection handling.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a pending or synchronous response entry for JSON-RPC calls, including timeout and response handling.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: A nested class within SmartLinkType managing connection state, subscriptions, and event handling.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC message over the WebSocket channel, handling message creation, sequence ID, and response waiting.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Performs a JSON-RPC method invocation, optionally with parameters and response handling.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a specific event with a callback handler.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a property or configuration via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a property or configuration via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Checks for expired callbacks and triggers cleanup.

methods.name: InternalInvoke
methods.description: Internal method to handle invocation and response parsing.
